title: Youth Bar Association of India v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Youth Bar Association of India v. Union of India, (2016) 9 SCC 473
content.holding: Directed that copies of FIRs must be uploaded on police/state government websites within 24 to 48 hours of registration, except in sensitive matters such as sexual offences or terrorism.
content.relevance: Transparency and prompt access to FIRs for bail and defense preparation.
